title: Evaluation of HER2DX Assay on Treatment Decisions in Patients With Early Stage HER2+ Breast Cancer: the HER2BREASTDX
official: Prospective Observational Monocentric Study to Evaluate the Impact of the HER2DX Assay on Treatment Decisions in Patients With Early Stage HER2+ Breast Cancer: the HER2-BREAST-DX
summary: To prospectively evaluate the impact of HER2DX on the decision-making processes of the treating physicians and especially among the routine multidisciplinary tumour board, in defining type and setting of systemic therapy administration in patients with stage I-III HER2+ BC, and the degree of clinician's confidence in the treatment recommendation.
conditions: Breast Cancer Early Stage Breast Cancer (Stage 1-3)
